description: Alibaba Cloud Parse-X intelligent document parsing and extraction tool. Supports two capabilities: (1) Parse — convert documents, images, and audio/video to structured Markdown/JSON/HTML with layout, table, and synopsis support; (2) Extract — schema-driven information extraction with citations from parsed or new documents. Uses Parse-X HTTP (Spectrum gateway, Bearer token via DASHSCOPE_API_KEY). **When to use this skill** — the user asks to: - Parse / convert / analyze any document, image, spreadsheet, or media file (PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, Markdown, HTML, images, audio, video) - Extract structured fields or entities from a document - Convert files to Markdown or JSON format - Process files with mentions of: 解析, 文档解析, 文件解析, 表格, Excel, xlsx, xls, PDF, Word, PPT, 合同, 发票, 报告, 图片, 本地文件, 上传, markdown, JSON, 提取, 抽取, 字段, parse, extract, document parsing, parse file, 解析文档, 解析文件, 文件转换, 图片解析, 表格提取
